mapper.select: select user_id, award_order_id, credit_amount, state, retry_count from credit_award_task where state = 'pending' and retry_count < 5 order by create_time asc limit 10
mapper.update: update credit_award_task set retry_count = retry_count + 1, state = case when retry_count + 1 >= 5 then 'failed' else 'pending' end, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and award_order_id = #{awardOrderId}
